picks.title: How Decagon uses AI for design system saturation
picks.excerpt: Decagon uses Figma MCP to keep design specs and code in continuous alignment so AI coding agents can pull straight from the component library, and Figma Make to spin up multiple dashboard variants for customer feedback before committing engineering time — a concrete look at scaling a design system with AI in the loop.
picks.rationale: Concrete, reproducible play for design-system teams — Figma MCP keeps specs and code aligned for AI agents while Make prototypes variants, changing how a designer scales a system tomorrow.

picks.title: You can now deploy Lovable apps to Vercel
picks.excerpt: Vercel added one-click deployment for apps built in Lovable, closing the loop from AI prompt-to-app to production hosting — another step in the design-to-code pipeline where non-engineers ship real software from a conversational builder.
picks.rationale: Fresh, actionable pipeline shift — one-click Lovable-to-Vercel deploy lets designers push a vibe-coded app to production, distinct from the earlier Lovable own-changelog card.

picks.title: How to Lead Design Teams Through the AI Era
picks.excerpt: Design leader Jen Dunnam (ex-Patreon, Shopify) shares how she steadies teams amid constant AI-driven change — breaking problems down, rethinking what 'speed' means in design ops, choosing the right tools, and sharpening principles rather than chasing every new model.
picks.rationale: Credible practitioner playbook for design leads managing AI-era churn — a distinct interview from the earlier Config Leadership Collective recap, useful for how teams set process and tool choices.

picks.title: The Economist shades AI in sharp new billboard ads
picks.excerpt: Cocogun's new billboard campaign for The Economist leans on stripped-back, human-made visuals to position editorial craft against AI-generated sameness — a signal of how design and advertising teams are branding around (and against) generative AI.
picks.rationale: Notable brand campaign that designers can learn positioning from — a distinct Economist/Cocogun case, not the earlier Fi 'not AI slop' piece — showing how craft is being marketed against AI sameness.
